text.S1: There once was a little girl whose hair was bright and yellow, and it glittered in the sun like spun-gold. Her name was Goldi-Locs.
text.S2: There once was a little girl whose hair was bright and yellow, and it glittered in the sun like spun-gold. Her name was Goldi-Locs.
text.T1: Kwakalekale nekuna ni kasizana ka milili ye benya ni mubala wa n͂andatalukeke, ni kumyasaula haili mwa lizazi sina gauda yebenya. Libizo lahae neli Kolidi-lokisi.
text.T2: Kanako yeñwi nekuna ni kasizana ka milili yebenya ya mubala wa n͂andatalukeke yene inyandima mwa lizazi sina gauda yebenya. Libizo lahae neli Golidi-Lokisi.

text.S1: One day Goldi-Locs went out to gather flowers. She wandered on and on, and after a while she came to a forest, where she had never been before. She went into the forest, which was very cool and shady.
text.S2: One day Goldi-Locs went out to gather flowers. She wandered on and on, and after a while she came to a forest, where she had never been before. She went into the forest, which was very cool and shady.
text.T1: Zazi lelinwi kolidi – lokisi naile kwa kuyanga lipalisa. Na yambaezi nako yetelele, hasamulahonyana afita kwa mushitu, kwa samba abeteni mwa bupilo bw ahae. Nakeni mwa mushitu wonobata ahulu ni kafifi.
text.T2: Zazi lelinwi Golidi-Lokisi naile kwa kuyanga lipalisa. Ayambaela kafa ni kafa mi kasamulaho wa nako-nyana afita mwa mushitu, wanaa samba abeteñi mwa bupilo bwahae. Akena mwa mushitu wone ubata ni kafifi.

text.S1: She came to a house standing all alone in the forest. She knocked at the door, as she was tired, hungry and thirsty, and she hoped the good people inside would give her some food and drink, and let her rest a little while.
text.S2: She came to a house standing all alone in the forest. She knocked at the door, as she was tired, hungry and thirsty, and she hoped the good people inside would give her some food and drink, and let her rest a little while.
text.T1: Mwa mushitu atofumana ndu yeli inosi. A ngongota fa sikwalo nikwanakatezi, tala ni linyolwa mi nana nisepo yakuli batu ba bande bene bali mwahali nebakamufa sico ni sino, ni kumutuhela kuli apumule hanyinyani.
text.T2: Mwa mushitu ato fita fa ndu yene ili inosi. Angongota fa sikwalo ni kwanaa katezi, tala ni linyolwa mi aba ni sepo yakuli batu babande bane bali mwahali neba kamufa sico ni sino, ni kumutuhela kuli apumule hanyinyani.

text.S1: Although Goldi-Locs did not know it, this house belonged to three lions. There was GREAT BIG FATHER LION, mid-sized mother lion, and dear little baby lion who was no bigger than Goldi-Locs. The three lions had gone out for a walk while their supper was cooling, so when Goldi-Locs knocked at the door no one answered.
text.S2: Although Goldi-Locs did not know it, this house belonged to three lions. There was GREAT BIG FATHER LION, mid-sized mother lion, and dear little baby lion who was no bigger than Goldi-Locs. The three lions had gone out for a walk while their supper was cooling, so when Goldi-Locs knocked at the door no one answered.
text.T1: Nihaike kolidi – lokosi hakuna sanaziba, ndu ye neli ya litau zetaalu. Nekuna ni nganda tuna ya tau ya muuna, yamakutela kaufi ya musali ni ka mwana kene kasali kakanyinyani ku Golidi-Lokisi. Litau zetaalu zona neliile kwa kuzamaya-zamaya hane lisalitela kuli mulalelo wazona ufole. Kacwalo, Golidi-Lokisi hanaa ngongota, hakuna yanaa alabile.
text.T2: Nihaike Golidi-Lokisi hakuna sanaa ziba, ndu ye neeli ya litau zetaalu. Nekuna ni NGANDA-TUNA YA TAU YA MUUNA, yamakutela kaufi ya musali ni kamwana kane kali kakanyinyani ku Golidi-Lokisi. Litau zetaalu zona neliile kwa kuzamaya-zamaya hane lisalitela kuli mulalelo wazona ufole. Kacwalo, Golidi-Lokisi hanaa ngongota, hakuna yanaa alabile.

text.S1: She paused and she knocked again. As nobody answered she pushed the door open and stepped inside. There in a row stood three chairs. One was a GREAT BIG CHAIR, and it belonged to the father lion. And one was a middling-sized chair, and it belonged to the mother lion, and one was a dear little chair, and it belonged to the baby lion. And on the table stood three bowls of smoking hot porridge. “And so,” thought Goldi-Locs, “people must be coming back soon to eat it.”
text.S2: She paused and she knocked again. As nobody answered she pushed the door open and stepped inside. There in a row stood three chairs. One was a GREAT BIG CHAIR, and it belonged to the father lion. And one was a middling-sized chair, and it belonged to the mother lion, and one was a dear little chair, and it belonged to the baby lion. And on the table stood three bowls of smoking hot porridge. “And so,” thought Goldi-Locs, “people must be coming back soon to eat it.”
text.T1: Akutumana hanyinyani mi akutela kungongota hape. Anekusina mutu yana alabile akasha sikwalo ni kukwaululami akena mwahali mwa mukoloko nekuna ni lipula zetalu. Sapili neeli sesituna mi neeli sa mushemi wa tau ya muuna, sesitatama nesi sesituna ahulu mi neeli sa tau ya musali haili kapula ka bulaalu neli kaka tau ka mwana. Fa tafule nekuna ni mikeke ya kwiti ye milaalu mone kuna ni palica ye yuka, kolidi-lokosi a hupula kuli kuswanela kuba ni batu babataha kapili kuto ca palica yeo.
text.T2: Akutumana hanyinyani mi akutela kungongota hape. Hane kusina mutu yana alabile akasha sikwalo ni kukwahulula mi akena mwahali, mone kuna ni mukoloko wa lipula zetaalu. Ulimuñwi neeli wa SIPULA SESITUNA-TUNA, sa mushemi wa tau ya muuna. Womuñwi wotatama wa sipula sa fabuhali, neeli sa tau ya musali, haili kapula kakanyinyani kabulaalu neeli ka katau ka mwana. Fa tafule nekuna ni mikeke ya kwiti yemilaalu mone kuna ni palica yeyuka. “Ona cwana,” Golidi-Lokisi ahupula, “kuswanela kuba ni batu babataha kapili kuto ca palica ye.”

text.S1: She thought she would sit down and rest until they came. First she sat down in the GREAT BIG CHAIR, but the cushion was too soft. It seemed as though she would be swallowed. Then she sat down in the middle-sized chair, and the cushion was too hard, and it was not comfortable. Then she sat down in the dear little chair, and it was just right. It fitted her as though it had been made for her. So there she sat, and she rocked and she rocked, and she sat and she sat, until with her rocking and her sitting she sat the bottom right out of it.
text.S2: She thought she would sit down and rest until they came. First she sat down in the GREAT BIG CHAIR, but the cushion was too soft. It seemed as though she would be swallowed. Then she sat down in the middle-sized chair, and the cushion was too hard, and it was not comfortable. Then she sat down in the dear little chair, and it was just right. It fitted her as though it had been made for her. So there she sat, and she rocked and she rocked, and she sat and she sat, until with her rocking and her sitting she sat the bottom right out of it.
text.T1: Ahupula kuli utaina ni kupumula kufitela batu bataha. Aina mwa sipula sesituna, kono musamo wa sona neli wo bunolo. Nekubonisa kuli uka miziwa. Kihaina mwa sipula sesitatama, mi musamo notiile ahulu, mi nekusina ku iketa hande kwina mwateni hape kihaina mwa kapula ka kanyinyani, mi nekali kakande. Nesi mulikani handende kuli mane inge nesipangezwi yena. Ki yoo saina, ni kutengauka-tengauka, mi aina ni kuina hape, kufitela kutengauka ni kuina kwa hae aina kwa tasi handende.
text.T2: Ahupula kuina ni kuishumusa kufitela batu bataha. Akala pili kuina mwa SIPULA SESITUNA-TUNA, kono musamo wasona neu tofota hahulu. Alemuha kuli ukamu nefukisa. Ki haina mwa sipula sa fabuhali sesitatama, sa musamo otiile hahulu, mi nesisina buiketo. Cwale ki haina mwa kapula kakanyinyani, mi kona nekali hande. Kona neka mulikani handende kuli mane inge neka pangezwi yena. Mwateñi aina, anyendaela nyendaela, ni kuina-ina.

text.S1: And nobody had come, and there stood three bowls of porridge on the table. “They must not be very hungry people,” thought Goldi-Locs to herself. Or they would have come home to eat their supper.” And she went over to the table just to see whether the bowls were full.
text.S2: And nobody had come, and there stood three bowls of porridge on the table. “They must not be very hungry people,” thought Goldi-Locs to herself. Or they would have come home to eat their supper.” And she went over to the table just to see whether the bowls were full.
text.T1: Nifoo nekusina yanatile, mi nekuna ni mikeke ya kwiti yenenani palica fa tafule. Baswanela kusashwa tala,” Kolidi – lokisi ahupula cwalo isali yena. Kapa neba wanela kutaha kwa hae kuto ca mulalelo. Aya kwa tafule kuyo bona kapa mikeke ya kwiti itezi palica.
text.T2: Nicwale nekusina yanaa tile, mi nekuna ni mikeke ya kwiti yene ina ni palica fa tafule. “Habasika shwa tala batu ba,” kwahupula Golidi-Lokisi isali yena, “kapa neba kabe batile kwa hae kutolalela. Ki haya kwa tafule kuyo bona kapa mikeke ya kwiti nei tezi palica.

text.S1: The first bowl was a GREAT BIG BOWL with a GREAT BIG WOODEN SPOON in it, and that was the father lion’s bowl. The second bowl was a middle-sized bowl, with a middle-sized wooden spoon in it, and that was the mother lion’s bowl. And the third bowl was a dear little bowl, with a dear little silver spoon in it, and that was the baby lion’s bowl.
text.S2: The first bowl was a GREAT BIG BOWL with a GREAT BIG WOODEN SPOON in it, and that was the father lion’s bowl. The second bowl was a middle-sized bowl, with a middle-sized wooden spoon in it, and that was the mother lion’s bowl. And the third bowl was a dear little bowl, with a dear little silver spoon in it, and that was the baby lion’s bowl.
text.T1: Mukeke wapili neli womutuna ni lushwana lwa kota mwateni, mi woo neli wa tau ya muuna ya mushemi. Mukeke wabubeli nesi woo mutuna ahulu ni lushwana lolulikani lwa kota, mi neli mukeke wa tau ya mushemi ya musali. Mukeke wa bulaalu neli kakanyinyani ni kashwana kakanyinyani kene kabenya sina silibela, mi neli ka tau ya mwana.
text.T2: Mukeke wapili neeli MUKEKE WOMUTUNA-TUNA ni LUSHWANA LWA KOTA LOLUTUNA-TUNA mwateni, mi woo neeli wa tau ya muuna ya mushemi. Mukeke wabubeli wa fabuhali ni lushwana lwa fabuhali lwa kota mwateñi neeli mukeke wa tau ya mushemi ya musali. Mukeke wabulaalu neeli kakeke kakanyinyani ni kashwana kakanyinyani mwateñi kane kabenya sina silibela, mi neeli ka katau ka mwana.

text.S1: The porridge that was in the bowls smelled so very good that Goldi-Locs thought she would taste it.
text.S2: The porridge that was in the bowls smelled so very good that Goldi-Locs thought she would taste it.
text.T1: Palica yeo yeneli mwa mikeke ya kwiti ne nunka hande ahulu kuli Kolidi-Lokisi a hupula kuca kwateni kuli autwe moyutwalela.
text.T2: Palica yewo yene ili mwa mikeke ya kwiti nei nunka hande hahulu kuli Golidi-Lokisi ahupula Kui kutwisaca kwateñi kuli autwe moyi utwahalela.

text.S1: She took the GREAT BIG SPOON and tasted the porridge in the GREAT BIG BOWL, but it was too hot. Then she took the middle-sized spoon and tasted the porridge in the middle-sized bowl, and it was too cold. Then she took the little silver spoon and tasted the porridge in the dear little bowl, and it was just right. It tasted so good that she tasted and tasted, and tasted and tasted until she tasted it all up.
text.S2: She took the GREAT BIG SPOON and tasted the porridge in the GREAT BIG BOWL, bu it was too hot. Then she took the middle-sized spoon and tasted the porridge in the middle-sized bowl, and it was too cold. Then she took the little silver spoon and tasted the porridge in the dear little bowl, and it was just right. It tasted so good that she tasted and tasted, and tasted and tasted until she tasted it all up.
text.T1: Anga lushwana lolutuna ni kuutwa palica yeneli mwa mukeke wo mutuna, kono neicisa ahulu. Hape anga lushwana lolulikani ni kuutwa palica yeneli mwa mukeke wo likani mi palica nebatile ahulu. Hape anga kashwana kakanyinyani ka kaabenya ni kuutwa palica yeneli mwa kakeke ka kanyinnyani mi neyutwahalile hande ahulu. Palica neyutwahalile hande ahulu kuli nana ni kukutakutela kuutwa kufitela haifeza kaufela.
text.T2: Aanga LUSHWANA LOLUTUNA-TUNA ni kui kutwisa palica yene ili mwa MUKEKE WOMUTUNA-TUNA, kono nei cisa hahulu. Cwale ki haanga lushwana lwa fabuhali ni kui kutwisa palica yene ili mwa mukeke wa fabuhali mi palica nei bata hahulu. Hape ki haanga kashwana kakanyinyani ka kabenya ka silubela ni kui kutwisa palica yene ili mwa kakeke kakanyinyani mi nei utwahalile hande.

text.S1: And after that she felt very sleepy, so she went upstairs and looked about her, and there were three beds all in a row. The first bed was the GREAT BIG BED that belonged to the father lion. The second bed was a middling-sized bed that belonged to the mother lion, and the third bed was a dear little bed that belonged to the dear little baby lion.
text.S2: And after that she felt very sleepy, so she went upstairs and looked about her, and there were three beds all in a row. The first bed was the GREAT BIG BED that belonged to the father lion. The second bed was a middling-sized bed that belonged to the mother lion, and the third bed was a dear little bed that belonged to the dear little baby lion.
text.T1: cwale asamulawo aikutwa ahulu kozela, mi apahama kwa mizuzu ya kwahalimu kuyo talima kwateni. Kwateni ayo fumana mimbeta ye milaalu ye kolohani. Mumbeta wa pili neeli wo mutuna woo neeli wa tau ya muuna. Mumbeta wa bubeli woo likani neeli wa tau ya mushemi ya musali, mi mubeta wa bulaalu neeli kambeta kakanyinyani kaka tau ka mwana.
text.T2: Kasamulaho wa kui kutwisa palica cwalo, aikutwa hahulu kuozela, ki haa pahama kwa mizuzu ya kwahalimu kuyo talima kwateñi. Ayo fumana mimbeta yemilaalu. Mumbeta wapili neeli MUMBETA WOMUTUNA-TUNA wone uli wa tau ya mushemi ya muuna. Mumbeta wabubeli wa fabuhali neeli wa tau ya mushemi ya musali, mi mumbeta wabulaalu neeli kambeta kakanyinyani ka katau ka mwana.

text.S1: Goldi-Locs lay down on the GREAT BIG BED to try it, but the pillow was too firm and she wasn’t comfortable at all.
text.S2: Goldi-Locs lay down on the GREAT BIG BED to try it, but the pillow was too firm and she wasn’t comfortable at all.
text.T1: Kolidi-lokisi alika kuloba lafa mumbeta wo mutuna kono musamo notiile ahulu mi nasikaiketa hande alobezi fateni.
text.T2: Golidi-Lokisi alobala fa MUMBETA WOMUTUNA-TUNA kuulika, kono musamo neu tiile hahulu mi naasika iketa hande halobezi fateñi.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the middle-sized bed, and the pillow was too soft, and that wasn’t comfortable either.
text.S2: Then she lay down on the middle-sized bed, and the pillow was too soft, and that wasn’t comfortable either.
text.T1: Hape alobala fa mumbeta wa bubeli wolikani mi musamo noli bunolo ahulu nikusamufa kozo.
text.T2: Ki haa lobala fa mumbeta wa fabuhali foo musamo neuli bunolo hahulu mi niwona neusika mufa buiketo.

text.S1: Then she lay down on the dear little bed and it was exactly right, and so very comfortable that she lay there and lay there until she went fast asleep.
text.S2: Then she lay down on the dear little bed and it was exactly right, and so very comfortable that she lay there and lay there until she went fast asleep.
text.T1: Alobala fa kambeta kakanyinyani mi nekali hande ahulu mi naiketile hande kuli mane saikela fa buloko.
text.T2: Cwale alobala fa kambeta kakande kakanyinyani mi kona nekali hande hahulu mi nai ketile hande kuli mane halobezi cwalo sai kela fa buloko.

text.S1: While Goldi-Locs was still asleep in the little bed, the three lions came home again, and as soon as they stepped inside the door and looked around, they knew that somebody had been there.
text.S2: While Goldi-Locs was still asleep in the little bed, the three lions came home again, and as soon as they stepped inside the door and looked around, they knew that somebody had been there.
text.T1: Kolidi – Lokisi hanaitobalezi cwalo fa kambeta kakanyinyani litau zetaalu zafita fa hae. Kapili-pili lisakena mwa muzuzu ni kutalima-talima zalemuha kuli nekubile ni mutu fa sibaka seo.
text.T2: Golidi-Lokisi hane asa itobalezi cwalo fa kambeta kakande kakanyinyani litau zetaalu zafita fa hae hape. Kapili-pili lisakena mwa muzuzu ni kutalima-talima zalemuha kuli nekubile ni mutu fa sibaka sewo.

text.S1: “SOMEBODY’S BEEN SITTING IN MY CHAIR,” growled the father lion in his great big voice, “AND LEFT THE CUSHION CROOKED.”
text.S2: “SOMEBODY’S BEEN SITTING IN MY CHAIR,” growled the father lion in his great big voice, “AND LEFT THE CUSHION CROOKED.”
text.T1: “Kuna ni mutu yana inzi mwa sipula saka”, kwa buluma tau ya mushemi ya muuna kalinzwi lelituna, ni kusuya musamo inge ubunjukile.
text.T2: “KUNA NI MUTU YANAA INZI MWA SIPULA SAAKA,” kwabuluma tau ya mushemi ya muuna ka linzwi lelituna, “NI KUSUYA MUSAMO INGE UKOKONYANI.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” said the mother lion, “and left it standing crooked.”
text.S2: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” said the mother lion, “and left it standing crooked.”
text.T1: “Kunani mutu yanainzi mwa sipula saka”, tau ya musahali ya bulela,” ni kusisiya sisikami.
text.T2: Kuna ni mutu yanaa inzi mwa sipula saaka,” tau ya musali yabulela, “ni kusisiya sisikami.

text.S1: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” squeaked the baby lion, in his shrill little voice, “and they broke it”; and he felt very sad about it.
text.S2: “And somebody’s been sitting in my chair,” squeaked the baby lion, in his shrill little voice, “and they broke it”; and he felt very sad about it.
text.T1: “Kunani mutu yana inzi mwa sipula saka” ka tau ka mwana kaciana, ni linzwi lelimaswe lelisisani, mi sa siloba sipula, ka ikutwa maswabi kataba yeo.
text.T2: “Kuna ni mutu yanaa inzi mwa sipula saaka,” katau ka mwana kaciana, ni linzwi lelitiisa lelisisani, “mi asiloba.” Katau kai kutwa maswabi ka taba yewo.

text.S1: Then the three lions went over to the table to get their porridge.
text.S2: Then the three lions went over to the table to get their porridge.
text.T1: Cwale litau zetaalu zaya kwa tafule kuli liyo kushuka palica yazona.
text.T2: Cwale litau zetaalu zaya kwa tafule kuli liyo kushuka palica yazona.

text.S1: “WHAT’S THIS!” growled the father lion, in his great big voice, “SOMEBODY’S BEEN TASTING MY PORRIDGE, AND LEFT THE SPOON ON THE TABLE.”
text.S2: “WHAT’S THIS!” growled the father lion, in his great big voice, “SOMEBODY’S BEEN TASTING MY PORRIDGE, AND LEFT THE SPOON ON THE TABLE.”
text.T1: “Ki n͂i se! kwa buluma tau ya muuna ni linzwi lelituna, “kunani mutu ya cile mwa palica yaka, ni kusiya lishwana fa tafule”
text.T2: “KI SIKAMAÑI SE!” tau ya muuna ya mushemi yabuluma ka linzwi lelituna hahulu, “KUNA NI MUTU YANAA IKUTWISA PALICA YAAKA NI KUSIYA LUSHWANA FA TAFULE.

text.S1: “And somebody’s been taking my porridge,” said the mother lion in her middle-sized voice, “and they’ve splashed it all over.”
text.S2: “And somebody’s been taking my porridge,” said the mother lion in her middle-sized voice, “and they’ve splashed it all over.”
text.T1: “Kuna ni mutu yana sweli kunga palica yaka,” kwa bulela tau ya musali ka linzwi lelishiami, neba iyubainzi
text.T2: “Kuna ni mutu yanaa sweli kuca palica yaaka,” kwabulela tau ya musali ya mushemi ka linzwi la fasihali, “mane uyi hasakezi libaka kaufela.”

text.S1: “And somebody’s been tasting my porridge,” squealed the baby lion, “and they finished it.” And the baby lion looked sad as if he were about to cry.
text.S2: “And somebody’s been tasting my porridge,” squealed the baby lion, “and they finished it.” And the baby lion looked sad as if he were about to cry.
text.T1: . “Kuna ni mutu yana cile mwa palica yaka,” kwa lila ka tau kamwana, “mi ifelizwe” ka tau kamwana ka bonahala maswabi inge kakabata kulila.
text.T2: “Kuna ni mutu yanaa ikutwisa palica yaaka,” kwa cowila katau ka mwana, “mi baifelize.” Ka tau ka mwana kabonahala maswabi inge kakabata kulila.

text.S1: “If somebody’s been here they must be here still,” said the mother lion; so the three lions went upstairs to look.
text.S2: “If somebody’s been here they must be here still,” said the mother lion; so the three lions went upstairs to look.
text.T1: “Haiba kuli nekuna ni mutu fa uzibe usaliteni, “kwa bulela tau ya musali kacwalo litau zetaalu zaliba kwa muzuzu wa kwa halimu.
text.T2: “Haiba nji nekuna ni mutu fa, uzibe kuli usaliteñi,” kwabulela tau ya mushemi ya musali. Kacwalo, litau zetaalu zakambamela kwa musiyo wa kwahalimu.

text.S1: First the father lion looked at his bed. “SOMEBODY’S BEEN LYING ON MY BED AND PULLED THE COVERS DOWN,” he growled in his great big voice.
text.S2: First the father lion looked at his bed. “SOMEBODY’S BEEN LYING ON MY BED AND PULLED THE COVERS DOWN,” he growled in his great big voice.
text.T1: Tau ya muuna ya talima fa mumbeta pili “Kuna ni mutu yana lobezi fa mumbeta waka ni kuzusa masila,” ya buluma ka linzwi la yona lelituna.
text.T2: Ka kukala, tau ya mushemi ya muuna yatalima fa mumbeta, “KUNA NI MUTU YANAA LOBEZI FA MUMBETA WAAKA NI KUHOHELA FAFASI MASILA AKU APALA,” yabuluma ka linzwi lelituna.

text.S1: Then the mother lion looked at her bed. “Somebody’s been lying on my bed and pulled the pillow off,” said she in her middle-sized voice.
text.S2: Then the mother lion looked at her bed. “Somebody’s been lying on my bed and pulled the pillow off,” said she in her middle-sized voice.
text.T1: Tau ya musali niyona ya talima fa mumbeta wayona. “kuna ni mutu yana lobezi fa mumbeta waka ni kuzusa musamo fa teni, “nebulezi cwalo ka linzwi layona lelishiami.
text.T2: Tau ya musali ni yona yatalima fa mumbeta wayona, “Kuna ni mutu yanaa lobezi fa mumbeta waaka ni kuzusa musamo fateñi,” yabulela cwalo ka linzwi layona la fabuhali lelishiami.

text.S1: Then the baby lion looked at his bed, and there lay little Goldi-Locs with her cheeks as pink as roses, and her golden hair all spread over the pillow.
text.S2: Then the baby lion looked at his bed, and there lay little Goldi-Locs with her cheeks as pink as roses, and her golden hair all spread over the pillow.
text.T1: Ka tau ka mwana nikona ka talima fa mumbeta wa kona, foo nekulobezi Kolidi-Lokisi yo munyinyani ni lilama ze fubelunyana sina lipalisa, ni milili ya gauda yene hasani fa musamo.
text.T2: Katau ka mwana ni kona katalima fa mumbeta wakona, fone kulobezi kasizana kakanyinyani kange Golidi-Lokisi ni malama akona amafubelunyana inge lipalisa ni milili yakona ya gauda ihasani fa musamo.

text.S1: “Somebody’s been lying in my bed,” squeaked the baby lion joyfully, “and she is still here!”
text.S2: “Somebody’s been lying in my bed,” squeaked the baby lion joyfully, “and she is still here!”
text.T1: “kuna ni mutu yana lobezi fa mumbeta kwaciana katau ka mwana kakutaba ahulu, mi usaliteni fa!”
text.T2: “Kuna ni mutu yanaa lobezi fa mumbeta waaka,” kwacowila katau ka mwana, inge katabile hahulu, “mi usaliteñi fa.”

text.S1: Now when Goldi-Locs heard the great big father lion’s voice she dreamed it was the thunder rolling through the heavens.
text.S2: Now when Goldi-Locs heard the great big father lion’s voice she dreamed it was the thunder rolling through the heavens.
text.T1: Cwale Kolidi-Lokisi autwa linzwi lelituna la tau ya muuna a lola inge mulumo wa pula yesweli kufetauha mwa halimu.
text.T2: Cwale Golidi-Lokisi hautwa linzwi lelituna la tau ya muuna, alola inge mulumo wa pula yesweli kufetauha mwahalimu.

text.S1: And when she heard the mother lion’s middle-sized voice she dreamed it was the wind blowing through the trees.
text.S2: And when she heard the mother lion’s middle-sized voice she dreamed it was the wind blowing through the trees.
text.T1: Hape a toutwa linzwi lelishiami la tau ya musali alola inge moya wofukisa likota.
text.T2: Hape hautwa linzwi la fabuhali la tau ya musali ya mushemi alola inge moya wofukisa likota.

text.S1: But when she heard the baby lion’s voice it was so shrill and sharp that it woke her right up. She sat up in bed and there were the three lions standing around and looking at her.
text.S2: But when she heard the baby lion’s voice it was so shrill and sharp that it woke her right up. She sat up in bed and there were the three lions standing around and looking at her.
text.T1: Kono cwale a toutwa linzwi la ka tau ka mwana lene lisatabisi ni kutaluka la muzusa fa buloko onafo. Azuha ni kuina fa mumbeta mi nekuna ni litau zetaalu zene muyemelezi inge limutalimezi.
text.T2: Kono cwale hato utwa linzwi la katau ka mwana lene litiisa ni kutaluka la muzusa fa buloko onafo. Azuha ni kuina fa mumbeta mi nekuna ni litau zetaalu zene limuyemelezi inge limutalimezi.

text.S1: “Oh, my goodness me!” cried Goldi-Locs. She tumbled out of bed and ran to the window. It was open, and out she jumped before the lions could stop her. Then home she ran as fast as she could, and she never went near the forest again. And the little baby lion cried and cried because he had wanted to play with her.
text.S2: “Oh, my goodness me!” cried Goldi-Locs. She tumbled out of bed and ran to the window. It was open, and out she jumped before the lions could stop her. Then home she ran as fast as she could, and she never went near the forest again. And the little baby lion cried and cried because he had wanted to play with her. T1. “Aaa, ki nto yende kuna!” kwa lila Kolidi-Lokisi. Atula fa mumbeta ni ku matela kwa lihaulo. Nelikwahuluhile mi atula ni kuzwa pili litau lisika muyemisa. A mata kuliba kwa hae kapili ka mwanamonela mi nasikaya bukaufi ni mushitu hape. Ka tau ka mwana kalila katata mi libaka neli kuli nekabata kubapalanga ni yena.
text.T2: “Oho, ki nto yende kuna!” Golidi-Lokisi alila. Apindumuka fa mumbeta ni kumatela kwa lihaulo. Neli kwaluhile mi atulela kwande pili litau lisika muyemisa. Amatela kwa hae ka lubilo lolutuna mi naa sikaya bukaufi ni mushitu hape. Katau ka mwana kalila kataata bakeñisa kuli kona neka bata kubapalanga ni kasizana.
